title.narrative: Phase 3 Community Action for Peace and Socio Economic Dev. (a Consortium of WIC and JDPC Kafanchan)

description.narrative:
This project represents Year 3 of a peacebuilding and livelihood resilience initiative implemented by Justice Development and Peace Commission (JDPC) Kafanchan and the Women’s Interfaith Council (WIC) in Jama’a and Zangon Kataf LGAs of Kaduna State. It builds on previous phases to consolidate gains and institutionalise sustainable peace and socio-economic systems within target communities.
The project addresses persistent ethno-religious tensions, farmer–herder conflicts, weakened social cohesion, youth vulnerability, and fragile livelihoods. Rather than creating parallel structures, it strengthens existing religious, traditional, and community institutions to serve as durable platforms for dialogue and mediation. Faith and traditional leaders, women, and youth are equipped with skills in Freedom of Religion and Belief (FoRB), mediation, and Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR), leading to the establishment of functional community-based ADR cells that resolve disputes before escalation.
Peace education in secondary schools and community sensitisation activities promote interfaith trust and long-term norm change, while trauma counselling supports individuals affected by conflict. To address economic drivers of tension, the project promotes organic agriculture, improved ginger production, and Savings and Internal Lending Communities (SILC) to enhance household income and financial inclusion.
Structured farmer–herder dialogue and advocacy with local authorities support negotiated solutions and sustainable resource management. Through integrated peacebuilding, livelihood strengthening, gender inclusion, and institutional accountability, the project consolidates community ownership and reinforces durable peace and resilience systems.
